hostname.description: Fully-qualified domain name (FQDN) used for SMTP HELO and banner identification.

local_domains.description: List of domains whose mail is delivered locally (not relayed).

relay_domains.description: Domains for which this server will accept and relay mail (e.g., partner domains).

relay_hosts.description: List of IPs/CIDRs allowed to relay mail without authentication. Restrict to trusted hosts only.

daemon_interfaces.description: IP addresses the SMTP daemon listens on. Use ['127.0.0.1'] to restrict to localhost only.

smtp_port.description: TCP port for inbound SMTP (MTA) connections.

submission_port.description: TCP port for authenticated SMTP submission (client mail agents).

tls_enable.description: Enable TLS encryption for inbound and outbound connections.

tls_certificate.description: Path to server TLS certificate (PEM format).

tls_private_key.description: Path to server TLS private key (PEM format).

tls_ca_certificates.description: Path to CA bundle for verifying client/relay certificates.

tls_min_protocol.description: Minimum TLS protocol version supported (e.g., 'tls1_2' or 'tls1_3').

auth_sasl_plaintext.description: Allow PLAIN and LOGIN mechanisms over unencrypted connections (dangerous—set to false unless restricted to localhost).

auth_mechanisms.description: List of SASL authentication mechanisms to support (order matters).

maildir_path_template.description: Template for Maildir path (uses %h = home dir, %n = user, %d = domain).

mbox_path.description: Path pattern for MBOX delivery (used only if local_delivery = mbox).

smart_host.description: Optional smart host for relaying all outbound mail (e.g., 'smtp-relay.example.com::587'). Leave empty for direct delivery.

dns_routing.description: Enable DNS lookups for remote delivery. Disable only in isolated environments.

max_parallel_inbound.description: Maximum concurrent inbound SMTP connections (protect against resource exhaustion).

msg_per_conn.description: Maximum messages allowed per SMTP connection (0 = unlimited).

smtp_timeout.description: SMTP connection timeout in seconds (including read/write).

queue_interval.description: Seconds between automatic queue runs (0 = disable).

acl_enable.description: Enable access control lists (ACLs) for fine-grained policy enforcement.

clamd_socket.description: ClamAV daemon socket (host:port or /path/to/socket). Set to '' to disable.

spamc_socket.description: SpamAssassin spamc socket (host:port or /path/to/socket). Set to '' to disable.

spam_score_high.description: SpamAssassin score above which mail is auto-rejected.

spam_score_low.description: SpamAssassin score above which mail is tagged as spam but accepted.

log_level.description: Log verbosity: 0 = minimal, 1 = verbose, 2 = debug (use sparingly in production).

log_file_path.description: Base directory for Exim log files.

main_log_path.description: Relative path (from log_file_path) for main transaction log.

reject_log_path.description: Relative path for log of rejected messages.

panic_log_path.description: Relative path for panic/error log (critical failures only).

exim_user.description: System user for dropping privileges after startup (must exist).

message_size_limit.description: Maximum message size in bytes (0 = unlimited). Default: 50 MB.

queue_max.description: Maximum number of messages allowed in the queue.

deferred_expiry.description: Seconds to retain deferred messages before removal (0 = never expire). Default: 7 days.
